metadata.Name: Japanese Word Similarity Dataset
metadata.Description: The first Japanese word similarity dataset created to evaluate distributed word representations. It contains various parts of speech, including rare and common words, annotated by humans on a 10-point scale.
Derived From: Evaluation Dataset of Japanese Lexical Simplification
metadata.Paper Title: Construction of a Japanese Word Similarity Dataset
metadata.Venue Title: Proceedings of the Eleventh International Conference on Language Resources and Evaluation (LREC 2018)
metadata.Venue Name: International Conference on Language Resources and Evaluation
metadata.Abstract: An evaluation of distributed word representation is generally conducted using a word similarity task and/or a word analogy task. There are many datasets readily available for these tasks in English. However, evaluating distributed representation in languages that do not have such resources (e.g., Japanese) is difficult. Therefore, as a first step toward evaluating distributed representations in Japanese, we constructed a Japanese word similarity dataset. To the best of our knowledge, our dataset is the first resource that can be used to evaluate distributed representations in Japanese. Moreover, our dataset contains various parts of speech and includes rare words in addition to common words.
